name: Ikkei Ukai
excerpt: Ikkei Ukai is the original coach who mentors Hinata.
notes:
Ikkei teaches Hinata about the importance of the spiker's role in a quick strike.
He sets up different tempos for Hinata to practice blocking.
Ikkei explains that the quick strike is led by the spiker.
He encourages Hinata to improve and not fall behind Kageyama.
